Could this double-count the shipped login-keyboard-dismissal gap? Ruled out by checking directly: zero review-id overlap between the two keyword clusters, and the failure modes are unrelated (keyboard focus vs. captcha rendering/validation). Device/platform diversity across the cluster (Android app, Chrome/Safari incognito web, Samsung Galaxy Fold, tablets) rules out single-device fragmentation as the explanation.
